data.credibility: Management frequently guides long-term targets and reiterates them in subsequent quarters, but often drops topics or fails to provide updates in later calls. Working capital cycles missed the 50 to 55 days target by dropping to 15 days, while long-term margin and growth goals remain on track.

lines.line: Promised 50-55 days working capital; actual delivered at 15 days, missing the guided normalization.
Export contribution targeted above 10% by FY2030; status remains on track with periodic reiterations.
FMEG EBITDA margin target of 8-10% by FY2030 achieved 8% in Q1 FY27, staying on track.
EHV plant commissioning expected by next calendar year end delayed as reported in Q2 FY27.
Annual capex guided at 12 to 16 billion; actual was 14.8 billion before topic dropped.
FMEG segment targeted at 1.5x to 2x industry growth by FY30; consistently reiterated.
BharatNet scheme expected to generate 4.5 billion over 3 years; reiterated in Q1 FY27.
BharatNet O&M scheme expected to generate 3.5 billion for 10 years; topic was dropped.
Proposed dividend of INR 47 per share with 27.2% payout ratio; topic subsequently dropped.
Planned capex of INR 60 to 80 billion over 5 years; topic subsequently dropped.
Achieve 30% dividend payout ratio by FY2030; topic subsequently dropped.
EPC margin expected in mid- to high single digits; actual delivered at 11%.
Wires & Cables margin guidance maintained at 11% to 13% for medium to long term.
Expected around INR 800 crores from Bharat Net and RDSS this year; reiterated in Q2.
